rationale.conceptual: The method uses an established but non-trivial semiclassical Boltzmann transport framework under constant relaxation time. Implementing it requires understanding transport integrals, two-band bulk models, Dirac cone dispersion with curvature, and parallel-channel combination formulas. It is not a simple library call or textbook operation, but neither is it a novel research-grade algorithm. The difficulty lies in translating multi-component physics equations into correct, self-consistent code.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of three sequential steps: compute bulk, compute surface, then combine for nanowires. Each step produces a single CSV file. The reference solution uses one Python script with command-line switches; no complex tooling, no data assembly, no environment challenges beyond numpy/scipy. This is a straightforward 2-3 stage pipeline with simple I/O, far from fragile orchestration.
